biography: James Tanaka, a name echoing through the Finnish motorsport scene, began his racing journey not on asphalt, but on ice. Growing up in a small village near Rovaniemi, his first vehicle was a beat-up snowmobile, which he pushed to its absolute limit on frozen lakes, mastering the art of controlling a machine on the edge of grip. This early experience shaped his aggressive, borderline-reckless style. His first real taste of competitive racing came at age 14 in a local karting series. He showed immense talent, often winning despite using older equipment. A defining moment came during the Finnish National Karting Championship in 2022. Despite starting last due to a mechanical failure, he fought his way through the pack to finish third, showcasing his raw speed and never-give-up attitude. Now, at 17, James is making waves in the Formula Regional Nordic series, racing as an independent, fiercely determined to prove himself against the established teams and secure a spot in a top-tier racing academy. He is currently self-managed and looking for a more permanent seat.
drivingStyle: Tanaka’s driving style is characterized by a raw, untamed aggression. He attacks corners with a late-braking, high-risk approach, often flirting with the limits of adhesion. While this can lead to spectacular overtakes, it also results in costly mistakes. He is known for his relentless tire management, often pushing them beyond their optimal window in pursuit of every last tenth of a second. Under pressure, Tanaka tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes leading to errors, but occasionally producing moments of sheer brilliance. He trusts his instinct above all else, often ignoring team strategy in favor of his own gut feeling.

rivalries.reason: A fellow Finn with backing from a major racing academy, Lindstrom represents the established order that Tanaka is trying to disrupt. Their contrasting styles and personalities often clash on and off the track.
A calculating and consistent French driver, Dubois often capitalizes on Tanaka's mistakes. He sees her as a roadblock to his ambition, while she views him as an unpredictable threat.
Sato and Tanaka were teammates in karting but had a falling out after a controversial incident where Sato accused Tanaka of intentionally blocking him during a crucial qualifying lap.

quirks: Always wears a lucky blue wristband given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to a specific Finnish heavy metal song on repeat during the pre-race warm-up.
Refuses to eat anything other than reindeer jerky on race day.
careerHighlight: Finishing third in the 2022 Finnish National Karting Championship after starting last, showcasing his incredible overtaking skills and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of a Formula Regional Nordic race at Alastaro Circuit due to overconfidence, costing him valuable championship points.
